title: ICAI CA Intermediate September 2026 Results Declared Today!
content:
# ICAI CA Intermediate September 2026 Results Declared Today!

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne CA Intermediate September 2026 examinations ke results announce kar diye hain, as of today, October 22, 2026. All candidates who appeared for the exam can now check their scores.

Here are the key details:

*   **Result Declaration Date:** October 22, 2026.
*   **How to Check Results:** Candidates can access their marksheets and check their results on the official website, caresults.icai.org, by entering their six-digit roll number and registration number.
*   **Exam Period:** The CA Intermediate examinations for September 2026 were conducted between September 1 and September 12, 2026.
*   **Passing Percentages (September 2026):**
    *   **Group I:** 23.14% (23,210 out of 100,301 candidates passed).
    *   **Group II:** 18.92% (12,938 out of 68,400 candidates passed).
    *   **Both Groups:** 13.21% (5,066 out of 38,339 candidates passed).
*   **Toppers:** Neel Rajesh Shah from Mumbai and Chandak Sakshi from Nashik secured All India Rank 1 with 83.67% (502 marks). Shruti V from Chennai secured Rank 2 with 82.00% (492 marks), and Prem Agarwal from Surat secured Rank 3 with 81.67% (490 marks).
